name: Vaud

authority.name: Office cantonal du registre du commerce

sources.title: Vaud — Société anonyme (SA)
sources.reference: Changes to directors and signing powers

steps.title: Review Vaud commercial register instructions
steps.description: Consult the current Vaud guidance for the company's legal form and requested change.

steps.title: Prepare the modification application
steps.description: Prepare a French-language réquisition de modification containing the relevant information and authorised signatures.

steps.title: Review the supporting decision record
steps.description: Determine the applicable requirements for original minutes or an acceptable extract of the decision.

steps.title: Verify permitted submission method
steps.description: The Vaud registry does not accept ordinary email modification applications. Check the permitted counter or postal submission procedure.

steps.title: Check signatures on the SA application
steps.description: Verify signatures according to the company's registered representation and the applicable cantonal instructions.

warnings: Certain modifications to the articles of association require a notarial procedure.

steps.title: Check signatures on the Sàrl application
steps.description: Verify signatures by the competent managers or authorised signatories under the applicable instructions.

warnings: Use Sàrl-specific instructions rather than assuming that SA appointment documents are identical.

steps.title: Check appointment evidence
steps.description: Review the competent body's appointment decision, mandate acceptance and any supporting identity or signature documents.

steps.title: Check Swiss domicile evidence
steps.description: Determine whether a recent municipal domicile certificate is required for a person whose registration establishes the company's representation in Switzerland.

warnings: For a new SA board member, consult the specific Vaud guidance on the original general meeting minutes, filing signatures and signature legalisation.

steps.title: Check departure or removal evidence
steps.description: Review the resignation letter or the relevant corporate decision record supporting removal from the register.

steps.title: Verify cancellation of representation powers
steps.description: Check whether the departing person's registered signing powers must also be cancelled.

warnings: A departing officeholder may, subject to the applicable requirements, request cancellation of their own registration.

steps.title: Review the signing-authority decision
steps.description: Check the competent body's resolution and the precise signing mode to be registered.

steps.title: Review signature legalisation
steps.description: Check whether a new authorised signatory must have their specimen signature legally certified.

warnings: Distinguish granting signing authority from cancelling an existing registered signature.
Cantonal procedures must be checked against the current official instructions before filing.
An ordinary email is not an accepted filing channel for these modification procedures.
Original supporting documents or acceptable extracts may be required.
Changes to the articles of association may require additional formalities.
This dataset is preliminary and requires professional legal review.
